description: This file defines the interface for a Person grain in Orleans, including related data structures such as PersonAttributes and GenderType, and methods for registration, marriage, and testing.

classes.name: PersonAttributes
classes.description: Serializable class representing personal attributes including first name, last name, and gender.

classes.name: GenderType
classes.description: Enumeration for gender types: Male and Female.

methods.name: RegisterBirth
methods.description: Registers a person's birth with provided attributes.

methods.name: Marry
methods.description: Initiates marriage with a specified spouse.

methods.name: RunTentativeConfirmedStateTest
methods.description: Runs a test related to tentative and confirmed state.
